name: audio
description: Local-first text-to-speech: turn text into spoken wav/mp3, fully on-device. Two engines — piper (default, self-contained, a pinned checksummed voice model) and kokoro (opt-in, higher quality + multilingual incl pt-BR, needs espeak-ng). Both run via uv's tool runner (uvx, acquired at pinned versions); only model weights/voices are fetched. Degrades to a clear unavailable hint when a dependency is missing. Not music/SFX, not voice cloning, not remote/paid TTS.

espeak-ng.manual: Install espeak-ng (the phonemizer Kokoro needs) — Debian/Ubuntu `sudo apt install espeak-ng`; Fedora `sudo dnf install espeak-ng`; Arch `sudo pacman -S espeak-ng`; macOS `brew install espeak-ng`. Only required for --engine kokoro.

ffmpeg.manual: Install ffmpeg from https://ffmpeg.org/download.html (only needed for mp3 output; wav works without it).
